title: dendranthema lavandulifolium var. sianense
intro: Dendranthema lavandulifolium var. sianense, commonly known as Chrysanthemum Sianense, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family, Asteraceae. The plant is known to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Chrysanthemum Sianense include its ability to lower blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health, as well as its potential to treat fever and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
